# RxSafe

> > RxSafe provides pharmacy automation solutions and industry insights for independent pharmacies, long-term care operations, and specialty pharmacy programs.

RxSafe's info hub features educational content on pharmacy automation technologies, business models like LTC@Home, and financial optimization strategies including tax deductions. The site serves independent pharmacists and pharmacy owners seeking to improve operational efficiency, compliance, and profitability through automation.

- RapidPakRx
- LTC@Home

- LTC@Vantage Bundle
